title: Interstage agent
description: Scaffold plugins/interstage/agents/<name>.md with the required sections and the verbatim Operating rules.

name.description: Agent name (kebab-case); also the file name.

description.description: When to delegate to the agent (one line).
description.x-prompt: When should an orchestrator delegate to this agent?

role.description: Model role alias; the agent gets model "@<role>, @default".

tools.description: Comma-separated tools, for example "read, grep, glob". Not ask, todo or mission.

skills.description: Comma-separated autoload skills (is-<name>), at most 3, all from the core plugin, 20 KB total.
